contract.prompts: docs/data/serving-prompts.json: first BS frozen ShareGPT prompts repeated to 3000 tokens
contract.category_definition: GEMM includes all MXFP8 projections, BF16 BA and BF16 head; attention/GDN exclude these projections; fused persistent BA belongs to GDN
contract.attribution: 65 common RMSNorm kernels delimit the 32 layers; 3 GDN / 1 full attention repeated 8 times; generic copies/zeros assigned by layer region
contract.other: common residual/RMSNorm, activation quantization, fused SwiGLU+quant, embedding, sampling and scheduling
contract.timing: category values sum CUDA kernel durations; overlap counts twice; GPU span is first-to-last GPU kernel, and busy union removes overlap; profiler CPU/idle gaps can inflate span
contract.serving: HTTP TPOT = (last response-first visible text)/(completion tokens-1), includes mixed prefill during initial batch fill and later tail, plus frontend overhead; not fixed-BS CUDA step time
